text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 25) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 30 September 2023.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan atau penggunaan kenderaan motor di bawah kelas kenderaan

yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama, di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual Kedua, pada hari dan masa yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3)

Jadual Pertama, dilarang.

Pengecualian

3. Pengecualian daripada larangan itu hendaklah diberikan bagi maksud dan dalam

hal keadaan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

PENGECUALIAN

1. Bagi maksud penyelenggaraan, pembaikan, peningkatan, pembersihan

dan pemugaran bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

2. Bagi maksud pemacakan, pemasangan, penyelenggaraan, pengubahan

atau pengalihan mana-mana struktur, kerja, peralatan atau apa-apa benda

di dalam, di bawah atau di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama.

3. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan kecemasan dan penguatkuasaan oleh agensi Kerajaan

dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.

4. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan pembersihan, pembuangan dan penghantaran

sisa domestik oleh kenderaan motor di bawah kelas kenderaan yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama seperti lori sampah, lori pembersihan

pembentungan dan lori vakum pembentungan.

5. Bagi maksud kecemasan jika penggunaan mana-mana jalan selain yang terdapat

dalam koordinat yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama menjadi

mustahil atau tidak sesuai.

Dibuat 27 September 2023

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 25) ORDER 2023

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 402/2023 published on 15 September 2023, notice was given

of the intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Minister of Works against the making

of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred

to in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 25) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 30 September 2023.

Prohibition

2. The driving or use of motor vehicles under the classes of vehicles specified

in column (2) of the First Schedule, on the part of the road specified in column (1)

of the First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, on the day and time

specified in column (3) of the First Schedule, is prohibited.

Exemption

3. Exemption from such prohibition shall be given for the purposes

and in circumstances specified in the Third Schedule.

THIRD SCHEDULE

EXEMPTION

1. For the purposes of maintenance, repair, improvement, cleaning and clearance

of the part of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

2. For the purposes of erection, installation, maintenance, alteration or removal

of any structure, works, apparatus or anything in, under or over the part

of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

3. For the purposes of emergency services and enforcement by the Government

agencies and local authorities.

4. For the purposes of cleaning services, disposal and delivery of domestic waste

by motor vehicle under the classes of vehicles specified in column (2)

of the First Schedule such as garbage truck, sewerage cleaning truck and sewerage

vacuum truck.

5. For the purposes of emergency if the use of any road other than which appears

in the coordinates specified in column (1) of the First Schedule is rendered

impossible or unsuitable.

Made 27 September 2023
